timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.description: Weekly hours built from hajiri. Supervisors submit, managers approve overtime.
timesheets.description_supervisor: Weekly hours for your sites, built from hajiri. Check them and submit for approval.
timesheets.generate_toast: {created} created, {refreshed} refreshed, {skipped} already submitted or approved.
timesheets.select_all: Select all timesheets that can be approved
timesheets.over_cap_hint: Overtime above {h} hours a week breaks the Labour Act limit. Approve less, or record the reason.
timesheets.empty_body: Build them from hajiri. Drafts are refreshed every time you build; approved weeks are never changed.
timesheets.approve_ot_hint: Claimed: {h} hours. You can approve less than claimed.
timesheets.approve_payroll_note: Payroll pays only approved overtime for this organization.
timesheets.legend: P present · H half day · A absent · L leave · PH public holiday · WO weekly off. Hours: regular, then overtime.
timesheets.policy_desc: How timesheets are built and how payroll treats overtime.
timesheets.policy_requires_approval_desc: When on, payroll uses overtime approved on weekly timesheets (prorated for weeks that cross months) instead of the overtime recorded on hajiri.
timesheets.policy_cap_hint: Labour Act: at most 24 hours of overtime a week.
timesheets.policy_daily_hint: A present day counts this many regular hours; a half day counts half.
timesheets.forbidden: Only owners, admins, HR and supervisors can see timesheets.
